name: meta-business-mcp
description: Safely inspect allowlisted Meta Ads, Facebook Page, and Instagram business data from Claude Desktop.
long_description: A local-first, read-only MCP gateway for Meta Business APIs. Connect your own Meta access token, explicitly allowlist the business assets Claude may inspect, and query ads, campaigns, insights, Pages, Instagram media, permissions, and token health. The extension does not include arbitrary Graph API access or expose a Meta mutation tool in its default policy. This independent project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta or Anthropic.

meta_access_token.title: Meta access token
meta_access_token.description: Access token for your own Meta developer app. Claude Desktop stores this sensitive value in the operating system credential vault.

ad_account_ids.title: Allowed ad account IDs
ad_account_ids.description: Comma-separated Meta ad account IDs, including the act_ prefix.

page_ids.title: Allowed Facebook Page IDs
page_ids.description: Comma-separated Facebook Page IDs Claude may inspect.

instagram_account_ids.title: Allowed Instagram account IDs
instagram_account_ids.description: Comma-separated Instagram professional account IDs Claude may inspect.

pixel_ids.title: Allowed Meta pixel IDs
pixel_ids.description: Comma-separated Meta pixel IDs Claude may inspect.

business_ids.title: Allowed Meta business IDs
business_ids.description: Comma-separated Meta business IDs Claude may inspect.
